elements.description:
Connections between people and organisations around one of them – direct and second-hand rings, relationships drawn
by strength, re-centring on click, and a panel and keyboard list of the connections.

properties.name: heading
properties.description: The heading, and the graph's name

properties.name: nodes
properties.description: People, organisations and anything else, each with a kind

properties.name: ego
properties.description: The node in the middle (the ego); by default the first person. Changed by the user unless tc-ego-change is prevented

properties.name: depth
properties.description: How far out to draw: 1 (direct connections) or 2 (theirs too). Changed by the user unless tc-depth-change is prevented

properties.name: kinds
properties.description: The kinds shown; empty for all. Changed from the legend unless tc-kinds-change is prevented

properties.name: selected
properties.description: What's selected: a node id, "edge:<edge id>", or null. Changed by the user unless tc-selected-change is prevented

properties.name: kindLabels
properties.description: Names for the kinds in the legend: { organisation: "Organisation" }

properties.name: centre
properties.description: The node in the middle: `ego`, or the first person, or the first node

properties.name: look
properties.description: Visual style: "standard" or "clean"; unset follows <tc-look-provider>, else "standard"

events.name: tc-ego-change
events.description: A node was put in the middle ({ ego, node }: RelationEgoChange); cancelable – prevented, `ego` stays as it was

events.name: tc-depth-change
events.description: Depth 1 or 2 was chosen ({ depth }: RelationDepthChange); cancelable – prevented, `depth` stays as it was

events.name: tc-kinds-change
events.description: A kind was shown or hidden from the legend ({ kinds }: RelationKindsChange); cancelable – prevented, `kinds` stays as it was

events.name: tc-selected-change
events.description: A node or a relationship was selected, or nothing ({ selected, node, edge }: RelationSelectedChange); cancelable – prevented, `selected` stays as it was

functions.name: relationEdgeId
functions.description: An edge's id: its own, or one made from its ends and words

props.name: title
props.description: The heading, and the graph's name

props.name: ego
props.description: The node in the middle – controlled when given

props.name: defaultEgo
props.description: The node in the middle on mount when `ego` isn't controlled; by default the first person

props.name: onEgoChange
props.description: A node was put in the middle

props.name: depth
props.description: 1 (direct) or 2 (their connections too) – controlled when given

props.name: defaultDepth
props.description: The depth on mount when `depth` isn't controlled

props.name: kinds
props.description: The kinds shown, empty for all – controlled when given

props.name: defaultKinds
props.description: The kinds shown on mount when `kinds` isn't controlled

props.name: onKindsChange
props.description: A kind was shown or hidden

props.name: selected
props.description: What's selected: a node id, "edge:<id>" or null – controlled when given

props.name: defaultSelected
props.description: The selection on mount when `selected` isn't controlled

props.name: onSelectedChange
props.description: A node or relationship was selected, or nothing

changelog: **People & profiles** - **Org Chart** (`tc-org-chart`) – reporting lines that fold, search that opens the way, pan and zoom, an outline when narrow. - **Person Hovercard** (`tc-person-hovercard`) – the profile card behind any name, with status and local time. - **Team Roster** (`tc-team-roster`) – a directory with everyone's local time and the team's best hour to meet. - **Relationship Graph** (`tc-relationship-graph`) – people and organisations around one of them, re-centring on click, with a keyboard list of every connection.

features.name: light-dark()
features.why: Every colour token is a light / dark pair; without it no colour token resolves.

features.name: color-mix()
features.why: Tints and washes mixed from the tokens.

features.name: Container size queries
features.why: Components adapt to the width they're given, not the window's.

features.name: :is() and :where()
features.why: Every rule is keyed on :where() so the page can override it.

features.name: scrollbar-width
features.without: Scrollbars keep the browser's default width.

features.name: adoptedStyleSheets
features.without: Each element type's CSS goes into one <style> element in <head> instead – it looks and works the same.

features.name: forced-colors media query
features.without: In a forced-colours mode the browser's own adjustments apply, without the components' fixes.
